name: my-browser
title: My Browser
description: Commands and utilities that automatically adapt to your default browser, so you never have to reconfigure when you switch.
author: elfitaflores

commands.name: open-my-browser
commands.title: Open My Browser
commands.description: Focus or launch your default browser

commands.name: set-my-browser
commands.title: Set My Browser
commands.description: Pick an installed browser to set as your system's default

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
